papers.title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Wang, Zhang, Luo, Wu, Liu et al. (ByteDance Seed)
papers.what: Matches per-token FLOPs, non-embedding parameters and KV cache at once to separate the benefit of looping a shared layer block from the extra compute prior comparisons quietly spent, finds looping the middle half twice saves 6.8 to 18.0 percent of training FLOPs on the compute-optimal frontier, and reports a downstream gain larger than the loss gap predicts.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); DeepSeek-V3 (2024, 2JCKA7GI); ST-MoE (Zoph 2022, WIGLUNFZ)

papers.title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
papers.authors: Yang, Wang, Galley, Singh, Inala et al. (Microsoft Research)
papers.what: Splits simulator quality into behavioral fidelity and guidance responsiveness, shows existing methods fail on opposite axes, and fits one simulator per student from sparse records through pooled training plus per-student specialization, reaching 0.51 and 0.91 on chess where GPT-5.4 reaches 0.23 and 0.72 and Maia2 reaches 0.45 and 0.27.
papers.builds_on: Machine Theory of Mind (Rabinowitz 2018, NEKX3K3N); CounselBench (Li 2025, GST6E6A6); Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024, Z9WZPMNU)

papers.title: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution
papers.authors: Zhang, Yang, Yu, Hua, Chen et al. (Shanghai AI Laboratory)
papers.what: Builds a foundation model on content-conditioned routing over structured memory states, then uses the same interface to carry a persistent capability state adapted at test time without touching the backbone, so safety is invoked by the model's own computation rather than by an external wrapper or a post-hoc fine-tune.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV); TTT Layers (Sun 2024, JEGI4IS7); Mamba (Gu 2024, XNI34DQX)

papers.title: ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training
papers.authors: Wu, Yang, Zhou, Sun, Liu et al. (Joy Future Academy)
papers.what: Learns manipulation dynamics from action-free egocentric video first and attaches actions in a short grounding stage second, raising real-robot zero-shot success from 36.1 to 77.8 percent as the unlabelled corpus grows past 120,000 hours while the labelled set is held fixed, with a slow-fast split that emits actions at 30 Hz on one RTX 4090.
papers.builds_on: World Models (Ha 2018, 938DAXZT); DINO-WM (Zhou 2025, W44RSJJI); Video Action Survey (Zhu 2020, RYGRHCG3)
